The 84 edges existed all along — this is a one-time coverage-driven re-baselining (sim_to_physics 0 -> 84, total 215 -> 299), NOT a regression: BASELINE_SIM_TO_PHYSICS in check_physics_sim_cycle.py was raised from 0 to 84 in the same commit. The +84 is entirely pre-existing coupling made visible; no new cycle edges were introduced. Downward trend from this new baseline is enforced by R1/R2/R3 going forward.
